replies.text: {"verdicts":[{"id":"T1","keep":true,"reason":"Design states open seller sign-up and chat with photos; concrete phishing abuse path."},{"id":"T2","keep":true,"reason":"Server-stored photos served without participant access check; concrete enumeration attack on private photos."},{"id":"T3","keep":true,"reason":"Design states full chat history in local phone database; device access discloses conversations."},{"id":"T4","keep":true,"reason":"Open sign-up plus server photo uploads; concrete storage/bandwidth exhaustion attack."},{"id":"T5","keep":true,"reason":"Distinct attack: malicious file content rendered in victim's chat, not resource exhaustion or disclosure."},{"id":"T6","keep":true,"reason":"Photos served as uploaded; EXIF GPS leak to stranger chat counterpart is a distinct harm."},{"id":"T7","keep":true,"reason":"Design names local-only chat storage and open sign-up; no server record ties abusive messages to identity."}]}
